name: What factors determine the cost of replacing kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of replacing kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost depends on kitchen dimensions, layout changes, and whether you select stock, semi-custom, or custom cabinets. Factors that impact your budget include box construction (such as furniture-grade plywood versus particleboard), door styles, specialty finishes, and built-in accessories like soft-close drawer slides or pull-out spice racks. If electrical or plumbing lines must be relocated to accommodate a new floor plan, those modifications will also adjust the final estimate. An in-home assessment provides an accurate quote tailored to your space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on kitchen size, cabinet materials (stock versus custom), layout reconfigurations, door styles, hardware choices, and any required plumbing or electrical work.
